!!! info "Two namespaces, two origins"

    **`Vhi.*`** is VHI's hand-written C# - what runs in the Godot scene. The two gRPC
    services live here: [`Vhi.VhiCanonicalControlService`](Vhi.VhiCanonicalControlService.md)
    renders what an application *controls*, and
    [`Vhi.VhiTrainingAidService`](Vhi.VhiTrainingAidService.md) carries what a
    recording *session* needs.

    **`Myogestic.Vhi.V2.*`** is auto-generated by `Grpc.Tools` at build time
    from [`proto/myogestic_vhi_v2.proto`](../grpc-api.md#the-full-contract): the
    typed request / reply messages, the `Kind` and `ContinuousEncoding` enums, and
    the server stubs those services implement. The namespace name follows protobuf
    convention - the same `.proto` is also vendored on the MyoGestic side. Edit the
    `.proto` (not these files) to change the wire contract.

    The legacy `Myogestic.Vhi.V1.*` namespace and `Vhi.VhiControlService` were removed
    with the v1 service; a client that still speaks v1 receives `UNIMPLEMENTED`.
